name: trafy-community
description: Trafy Community — community-based learning & hiring platform. Milestone 1: Identity.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/api & npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/db && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile
